title: Analytics team standup
transcript:
Data Analyst: Yesterday I finished the revenue dashboard draft, but the retention query is slow and needs an index review.
Engineering Lead: I can review the retention query today and propose an index plan before end of day.
Product Manager: The launch readout is on Thursday, so we need the dashboard screenshots and a short narrative by Wednesday morning.
Data Analyst: I will prepare the screenshots after the query is fixed. The narrative is mostly ready and feedback has been positive.
Engineering Lead: Please flag any blocker by noon tomorrow so we do not surprise the launch team.
